'''Rirsack''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Lar Ndigo]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] bravely [[Battle of Rirsack|fought]] there sometime during or prior to [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="ce3.1">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 1|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 1]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Rirsack was mentioned twice in the [[Dark Horse Comics|comic]] series [[Star Wars: Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost|''Star Wars: Crimson Empire III—Empire Lost'']] by [[Mike Richardson]], debuting in [[October]] [[2011]]. The planet was spelled "Rirsack" in [[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 1|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 1]] and "Rorsack" in [[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 4|''Empire Lost 4'']]. The proper spelling was confirmed by the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="EAOC" />
